note: Both sets capture the configuration, the two controllers, the sole generator-speed feedback, and the filter recursion/coefficient, and both repeat the same defects (a paraphrased "variable-speed, variable-pitch" quote and the filter type reduced to "recursive, single-pole exponential smoothing"). Set A additionally transcribes the filter state x[n]=y[n-1], input u, and the nacelle-yaw simulation note, but it invents a coefficient e^(-2πT_i f_c) (source has T_s) and omits both controller goals. Set B captures the two goals (maximize power capture below rated; regulate generator speed above rated) and the excluded nonpower-production/start-up/shutdown/nacelle-yaw scope, though its scope quote is misquoted ("normal braking functions" for "safety and protection functions"). On balance B preserves more of the page's substantive engineering claims, while A's extra items are mostly trivial symbol definitions plus one wrong formula value.
